name: How long does it take to insulate a garage?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to insulate a garage?

acceptedAnswer.text: A standard two-car garage usually takes one to two days to insulate once framing is fully accessible. If the project includes hanging, taping, and finishing drywall over the insulation, expect the timeline to expand to three to five days to allow joint compound to dry between coats. Preparation can affect this schedule: clearing wall perimeters, moving workbenches, and resolving any moisture leaks before installation begins ensures work progresses without delay.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installing insulation in a typical garage takes one to two days, while adding finished drywall usually extends the job to three to five days.
